title: Level-wise half purity (Theorem D) is reconstructible
statement_en: Every graph G on at least 3 vertices with a vertex u such that, for every j, either every neighbour y of u of degree j + 1 is forced, or every non-neighbour y ≠ u of degree j is forced, is reconstructible. Here y is forced if every ordered pair (x', y') with x' ≠ y', deg x' = deg u and G − x' − y' ≅ G − u − y has the adjacency of (u, y) (Theorem D of debe_codegree.md; contains the pure degree class).
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => ∃ u : Fin n, ∀ j : ℕ, (∀ y : Fin n, G.Adj u y → (G.neighborSet y).ncard = j + 1 → ∀ x' y' : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x').ncard = (G.neighborSet u).ncard → x' ≠ y' → Nonempty (G.induce ({u, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({x', y'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))) → G.Adj x' y') ∨ (∀ y : Fin n, y ≠ u → ¬ G.Adj u y → (G.neighborSet y).ncard = j → ∀ x' y' : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x').ncard = (G.neighborSet u).ncard → x' ≠ y' → Nonempty (G.induce ({u, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({x', y'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))) → ¬ G.Adj x' y'))
